description: We are Turkish Kebaps! We are an enthusiastic team of curious, innovative 6th-grade students with a deep passion for science, technology, and space exploration.
summary:
NASA Space is an exciting educational game created by five young developers: Arda, Hamza, Emre, Alp, and Omer, known as the Turkish Kebaps team.

Our goal is to combine education, technology, and adventure while making learning fun for children. The game includes 99 exciting missions that help players discover the challenges of space exploration.

The adventure begins inside a rocket. After 10–15 seconds, players land on the Moon and receive their first mission: collecting lunar soil samples. To complete this challenge, players must tap the soil at least 40 times within 15 seconds.

Players can enjoy the game alone or with their friends. Each mission develops useful skills, including hand-eye coordination, problem-solving, and quick thinking.

Our project also combines STEM education: Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics.

With NASA Space, we want to inspire young explorers to learn, discover, and dream of becoming future astronauts.

Get ready for an unforgettable space adventure!
